assetGapSpec.exactGap: There is NO dedicated non-harvestable forest art. Every tree, shrub and ground sprite in getArt().src is bound to a SOURCES definition with stock/yields/block, and live Gameplay reuses A.src.oak for grove trees that are solid and yield wood. Existing 24x32 trees are only 1.333x the 16x24 hero height, so they cannot form an overhead canopy; there is no mid-storey or non-harvestable undergrowth layer.
